about.bio: I'm Deepika Kukreja — a Product Manager with X years shipping user-centred products across B2C, growth, and platform teams. I work best when teams trust PM judgment on problem framing, when design and engineering share a crisp bet, and when we can point to metrics that moved after launch.
whatIBring: Full lifecycle ownership — strategy, roadmaps, PRDs, wireframes, and sprint leadership
Discovery through usability testing, user feedback, and analytics (SQL, Mixpanel, GA)
Accountability for outcomes, not output — crisp bets and measurable launches
domains: 0→1 product launches and growth loops at consumer scale
Data-informed experimentation — A/B tests, funnel analysis, cohort tracking
Cross-functional delivery across eng, design, data, and marketing

bullets: Redesigned onboarding for 2M+ users — activation up 34%, time-to-value down 18s
Led a 5-person squad (eng + design + data) to ship 3 major releases in 6 months
Defined north-star metric and instrumented cohort dashboards tracking retention by day-7/30
Built an enterprise feature-adoption platform — 41% increase in activation, NPS +12 pts
Ran 12 discovery interviews, 4 usability tests, and 2 survey rounds to define MVP scope
Partnered with sales to create self-serve onboarding that cut support tickets by 30%

skills.desc: Discovery, roadmaps, growth loops, and stakeholder alignment
Analytics, A/B testing, funnels, and measured bets
